pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhiruhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.4: yatheva mayaṃ sapajāpatikā nāvāya kīḷāma evamevime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya nāvāya kīḷantī ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhissantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.14.1: “yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūheyya uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.15: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū ca bhikkhuniyo ca sāketā sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggaṃ paṭipannā honti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.3: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo te bhikkhū etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.5: na bhagini kappati bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.6: tumhe vā paṭhamaṃ uttaratha mayaṃ vā uttarissāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.9: atha kho tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pacchā uttarantīnaṃ corā acchindiṃsu ca dūsesuñca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.10: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave tiriyaṃ taraṇāya bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhituṃ”
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.16.1: “yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūheyya uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyaṃ taraṇāya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.10: abhirūhāma bhagini abhirūhāmayya, abhirūhāmayya, abhirūhāma bhagini, ajja vā hiyo vā pare vā abhirūhāmāti saṃvidahati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.11: bhikkhuniyā abhirūḷhe bhikkhu abhirūhati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.12: bhikkhū abhirūḷhe bhikkhunī abhirūhati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.20: kukkuṭasampāte gāme, gāmantare gāmantare āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.21: agāmake araññe addhayojane addhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.2.1: saṃvidahite saṃvidahitasaññī ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhati uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā, aññatra tiriyaṃ taraṇāya āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.2.2: saṃvidahite vematiko ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhati uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā, aññatra tiriyaṃ taraṇāya āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.2.3: saṃvidahite asaṃvidahitasaññī ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhati uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyaṃ taraṇāya āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.2.4: bhikkhu saṃvidahati bhikkhunī na saṃvidahati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
